title: Spreading a single perfect open stalk homotopy
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open, and $P$ a strictly perfect cochain complex over $U$ [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let $V\subseteq U$ be open, $x\in V$, and let $a,b:P|_V\to P|_V$ be chain maps [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Suppose their images under the termwise open module stalk functor [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor] admit a homotopy. For any open $T\subseteq V$ containing $x$, there is an affine open $W\subseteq T$ containing $x$ on which the restrictions of $a,b$ admit a homotopy. There is only one fixed pair of endomorphisms; no inverse map is sought.

proof.text: Choose the input homotopy and lift its reverse-degree components inside T, obtaining Z, e and k. Mathlib Homotopy.map_nullHomotopicMap, nullHomotopicMap_comp and comp_nullHomotopicMap identify the stalk of the null-homotopic map of k with the conjugate of the corresponding stalk map. Naturality of e and the homotopy comm equation give equality with the stalk of R(a-b).

Apply bounded finite-retract chain-map equality to R(a-b) and nullHomotopicMap k. Restrict Mathlib Homotopy.nullHomotopy k hkzero to that neighbourhood; the obtained chain-map equality identifies its first endpoint with the restriction of a-b. Homotopy.equivSubZero gives a homotopy between the restrictions of a and b.

Choose an affine subneighbourhood. Restrict the homotopy again and transport it through named natural comparisons for iterated restriction, whose sheaf-level components are identities. Naturality and inverse identities identify the endpoints.

proof_origin.place: Expansion of the finite-component calculation in Tags 09RE and 0BC7 (2), using Tag 01CP; the categorical and finite-support assembly is written in Lean by M4.

theorem exists_affine_perfect_open_stalk_homotopy_spread
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsStrictlyPerfect X U P)
    (x : X) (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (a b : (((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      (homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ⟶
      (((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    (hab : Nonempty (Homotopy
      (((openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map a)
      (((openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map b)))
    (T : X.Opens) (hTV : T ≤ V) (hxT : x ∈ T) :
    ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hWT : W ≤ T), x ∈ W ∧ IsAffineOpen W ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy
        (((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE (hWT.trans hTV))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map a)
        (((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE (hWT.trans hTV))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map b))
